body:
Founder real-time, live report: 'locomotion going in reverse... hes moving backwards.' draw_player_skin_mannequin's facing_rad formula was copied verbatim from draw_player_skin_tyler, which uses a formula specifically calibrated (and live-screenshot-verified) for tyler_body's own oddball BVH-imported bind pose (-Z at rest) -- never re-verified for the glTF-imported robot kits, which conventionally rest facing +Z like every other model in the file (the box body's own 180-draw_yaw convention). Switched to match. Honest, not visually re-verified in this sandbox (no GL driver) -- needs founder confirmation. Also acknowledged and deliberately deferred per founder request: wandering bots patrolling outside the VOXWORLD arena wall (patrol waypoint placement already flagged as unverified against real wall geometry in S470's own commit). Commit: 59c83a2.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed robot kits walking backwards -- were using tyler_body's own facing convention
